columns.name: sexo_categoria
columns.expression: CASE WHEN trim(CAST("sexo" AS VARCHAR)) = '1' THEN 'male' WHEN trim(CAST("sexo" AS VARCHAR)) = '2' THEN 'female' WHEN trim(CAST("sexo" AS VARCHAR)) = 'M' THEN 'male' WHEN trim(CAST("sexo" AS VARCHAR)) = 'F' THEN 'female' ELSE NULL END

columns.name: sexo_status
columns.expression: CASE WHEN trim(CAST("sexo" AS VARCHAR)) IS NULL OR trim(CAST("sexo" AS VARCHAR)) = '' THEN 'missing' WHEN trim(CAST("sexo" AS VARCHAR)) = '1' THEN 'valid' WHEN trim(CAST("sexo" AS VARCHAR)) = '2' THEN 'valid' WHEN trim(CAST("sexo" AS VARCHAR)) = '0' THEN 'ignored' WHEN trim(CAST("sexo" AS VARCHAR)) = '9' THEN 'ignored' WHEN trim(CAST("sexo" AS VARCHAR)) = 'M' THEN 'valid' WHEN trim(CAST("sexo" AS VARCHAR)) = 'F' THEN 'valid' WHEN trim(CAST("sexo" AS VARCHAR)) = 'I' THEN 'ignored' ELSE 'unsupported' END
